code:
docker build -t myagent:0.1 .          # -t names (tags) the image; . is the build context
docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name myagent myagent:0.1
curl http://localhost:8000/health      # verify
description: Three commands that build the agent image, run it with a published port, and verify the health endpoint.

steps.description: `docker build -t myagent:0.1 .` builds the image. The comment says `-t` names (tags) the image and the dot is the build context, the folder Docker reads.
`docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name myagent myagent:0.1` runs the image detached, publishes port 8000, and names the container `myagent`.
`curl http://localhost:8000/health` verifies the service, hitting the same port that was published.

title: Build and Run the Image
